name: flux-monorepo
description: Gerenciador raiz do Projeto FLUX (Backend FastAPI + Frontend Expo)

scripts.dev: powershell -Command "Start-Process powershell -WorkingDirectory './Backend' -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-Command', 'uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'; Set-Location './Frontend'; npx expo start"
scripts.dev:web: powershell -Command "Start-Process powershell -WorkingDirectory './Backend' -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-Command', 'uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'; Set-Location './Frontend'; npx expo start --web"
scripts.dev:clean: powershell -Command "Start-Process powershell -WorkingDirectory './Backend' -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-Command', 'uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'; Set-Location './Frontend'; npx expo start -c"
scripts.backend: cd Backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.seed: cd Backend && uv run python user_seed.py
